cases.title: Nominal K1 useful private operations under local and impaired profiles
preconditions: One frozen integrated candidate serves 10,000 active publications with all required quorums available.
Reference hardware, source/data/model/config identities, seeds, two-operation closed-loop coordinators and local/impaired profiles are frozen.
Impairment is 50 ms base RTT with independent +/-5 ms per-direction variation and independent 1% packet loss each direction below TCP.
steps: Execute at least 1,000 balanced publish/search/mailbox submissions per profile across three independent executions, including cold, reconnecting and warm connections and separate eight-request bursts.
Record correct durable acknowledgements against original deadlines, achieved offered load, queueing, refusal/uncertain outcomes, retries, p50/p95/p99 and clustered 95% confidence intervals.
Inspect entry and destination observations for direct operation plaintext and original source-address exposure.
expected: Nominal good-operation rate is at least 99.5% with all required quorums available.
Local warm p95 is <=6 s; impaired p95 is <=8 s and p99 <=10 s; protected decisions remain <=3 s and private operations <=10 s.
There are zero duplicate user notifications and every retry/failure is charged and reported.
Entry sees no direct operation plaintext and destination sees no original source address.
No confidence interval that straddles a threshold is counted as a pass.
evidence_required: Per-profile/run operation counts and latency distributions with confidence intervals
Retry, refusal, uncertainty and duplicate-notice ledger

cases.title: Restart and exact-retry recovery preserves outcome and deduplicates notices
preconditions: A reviewed candidate has durable publish/search/match/mailbox operations with deterministic operation identifiers and notice state.
Fault points cover before and after persistence, acknowledgement, mailbox delivery and local notice persistence.
steps: Interrupt each operation at every frozen fault point and submit the identical original retry after restart, including lost original replies and delayed duplicates.
Submit changed payloads with the same identity and conflicting retries as negative controls.
Compare durable originals, accepted outcomes, allocations/spends, withdrawals, mailbox acknowledgements and user-visible notice history.
expected: An exact retry resolves to the original outcome without a second effect or duplicate notification.
A lost reply never converts a durable success into a conflicting operation; an uncertain outcome is not shown as acknowledged success.
Changed-payload identity reuse and conflicting retries are refused with evidence preserved.
No original, right, denial or required proof is discarded and no withdrawal is resurrected.
evidence_required: Fault-point manifest and exact candidate identity
Operation/notice dedupe ledger and negative-control results

cases.title: K2 adversarial fault matrix remains safe and bounded
preconditions: A complete reviewed new recovery path is integrated with five pinned members, quorum four and at most one Byzantine member.
The predeclared manifest varies process death during persistence, lost replies, partitions, stale restores, corrupt input, exhausted reservations and competing writers.
Original C/L/P/D/F, 2 GiB, 512 entries, 1 MiB metadata, 256 MiB work and 3 s/30 s limits are unchanged.
steps: Execute at least 1,000 meaningfully varied fault scenarios with authenticated-quorum outage/restoration timing and independent positive/negative controls.
Measure recovery from the point required keys, retained state and a usable authenticated quorum exist; report earlier outage separately.
Audit acknowledged operations, spends, withdrawals, proofs, physical storage and cumulative reconstruction/copy/decoder work.
expected: There are zero lost acknowledged operations, conflicting accepted spends and resurrected withdrawals.
Recovery p95 is <=5 minutes after authenticated usable quorum restoration.
Loss of quorum refuses progress rather than accepting or discarding history.
All scenarios remain within funded storage/work/deadline limits and every still-required proof survives.
A reproducible safety violation blocks regardless of aggregate results.
evidence_required: Complete varied fault manifest and scenario traces
Safety invariant assertions and failure counterexamples
RTO distributions and physical storage/work accounting

cases.title: One hundred lifecycle transitions cross the 64-configuration archive boundary
preconditions: FEAT-003 has a complete preflighted and independently reviewed new path and explicit campaign authorization; no stopped campaign body is reused.
The frozen schedule includes 100 rotation/recovery/compaction cycles, same-key witness replacement, cold genesis, warm recovery and prospective physical closure checkpoints.
steps: Execute the new predeclared 100-transition schedule across the current 64-configuration archive boundary.

At every transition verify four-copy availability during compaction, original pins/evidence/rights, proofs, policy continuity and complete prospective physical funding before any freeze/readiness/accepted intent/promise.
Record state, suffix, chain, decoder/copy work and storage separately at original limits.
expected: All 100 transitions complete correctly, including same-key witness replacement and crossing >64 configurations.
Every required proof and original survives with no unfunded promise or pre-modification ambiguous recovery.
Funded storage, 512-entry/1 MiB metadata, 256 MiB work and 3 s/30 s limits are preserved.
Any structural overflow or missing pending generation rejects the candidate rather than relaxing the cap.
evidence_required: Per-phase physical byte and work measurements

cases.title: Policy revocation freshness and reconnect authorization negatives
preconditions: Signed policies have effective cutoffs and the candidate includes connected, disconnected and reconnecting nodes plus conflicting-policy evidence.
The schedule includes emergency updates, same-key witness replacement, stale policy and replayed authorization attempts.
steps: Distribute emergency updates to connected nodes and measure availability.
Attempt new authorizations at, before and after cutoff using revoked, stale, conflicting and replayed policies, including while disconnected and immediately after reconnect.
Verify retained rights and evidence after correct current-policy authentication.
expected: Connected-node emergency-update availability p95 is <=60 s across 100 correct lifecycle transitions.
No new authorization under revoked policy occurs after its effective cutoff; 60 s is not permission to serve stale policy.
Reconnecting nodes authenticate current policy before authorization and disconnection never bypasses expiry.
Valid retained rights and conflicting-policy evidence remain available; refusal never becomes acceptance.
evidence_required: Update availability distribution and retained-evidence audit

cases.title: Eligibility malformed-input and denial behavior avoids automated AI decisions
preconditions: Eligibility provenance, deterministic admission rules and exact user-visible states are specified and independently reviewed.
Fixtures include malformed/expired/replayed credentials, unsupported claims, unavailable issuer and ineligible requests.
steps: Submit eligible, ineligible and malformed requests through the actual admission interface, including retries and restarts.
Attempt to influence admission using natural-language similarity, model outputs or unreviewed hosted/model routing.
Inspect automatic resolution, denial/uncertainty text, retries, notices and authorization effects.
expected: At least 95% of eligible requests resolve automatically in the complete K4 corpus; malformed or unverifiable requests fail closed without ambiguous success.
No embedding, model judgment or hosted AI route determines eligibility.
Exact retries do not amplify grants or duplicate notices; permanent denials remain denied and transient uncertainty remains distinguishable.
User-visible notice/error text accurately states the outcome without exposing claim secrets.
evidence_required: Eligible-denominator automation report and malformed negative matrix
Model/data-flow audit and exact retry/notice ledger

cases.title: K4 false grants Sybil fairness and issuer-loss qualification
preconditions: An independently labeled adversarial corpus declares eligibility source, attacker control, independent-claim acquisition cost, fixed issuance period, equal demand and equal-rights groups.
Community issuance has a reviewed issuer-loss/recovery design without a permanently connected issuer.
steps: Measure eligible false exclusions and ineligible false inclusions using their distinct denominators.
Present one eligibility claim through 100 identities and separately test independently acquired claims without conflating them.
Compare entitlement-normalized grants per equal-rights group and interrupt issuer availability during issuance/redemption.
Evaluate issuance/redemption linkability inputs for the separate K6 observer cases.
expected: False exclusion is <=2% of eligible requests and false inclusion is <=1% of ineligible requests.
One claim obtains no additional quota through 100 identities; independent-claim resistance is reported separately.
Equal-rights entitlement-normalized grants differ by at most 10% between groups and every group is reported.
Community issuance survives issuer loss without a permanently connected issuer and without weakening authentication.
evidence_required: Issuer-loss traces and independent fairness review

cases.title: Independent bilingual K5 quality at frozen model and pipeline identity
preconditions: Independent Spanish/English data has at least 1,000 queries, 10,000 publications and held-out relevance labels not generated by the evaluated embedding.
Development/test topics and paraphrases are separate; model, rewrite/preprocessing, thresholds, candidate filter and notification policy are frozen before testing.
steps: Run local cold and warm inference/matching on the frozen corpus and record per-language Recall@5, candidate-filter quality, user-notified precision and false-positive rate.
Record counts, denominators, confidence intervals, initialization and resource use without treating unjudged cross-pairs as negatives.
Inspect inference route to confirm no hosted provider or model-generated relevance labels.
expected: Recall@5 is >=90%, precision of notified matches is >=80% and false-positive rate is <=5%, reported per language and in aggregate.
All quality thresholds hold on the same candidate intended for K5 privacy and K1/K7 qualification.
Cold and warm costs are visible and no hosted inference or self-labeled evaluation contaminates results.
evidence_required: Corpus provenance, label independence and split manifest
Per-language quality metrics with denominators and intervals

cases.title: K5 cross-scope reconstruction and known-text attacks are separately blocking
preconditions: The frozen confidential-matching candidate declares public matrices/material, scopes, auxiliary knowledge and attacker capabilities for two separate games.
Each game uses 100-candidate target populations and frozen attack training/test splits.
The inherited baseline is retained as failed evidence and is not reused as an expected outcome.
steps: Run the cross-scope real-text reconstruction/linkage attack and record target identification separately.
Run the known-text identification attack independently with its declared auxiliary information.
Attempt score reversal and alternate classifiers under the frozen protocol; do not average games or claim Internet-wide safety from finite fixtures.
expected: Cross-scope reconstruction identifies at most 5% of targets among 100 candidates.
Known-text attack identifies at most 5% of targets among 100 candidates.
Each game passes independently on the same useful matching candidate; neither current 86-97% reconstruction nor 100% known-text failure can support a confidential claim.
A result below chance is not treated as privacy success when classifier reversal is available.
evidence_required: Separate attack code/configuration identities and identification rates
Independent privacy review and limitations statement

cases.title: K5 epoch migration preserves quality and exact notice behavior
preconditions: The confidential-matching candidate has versioned epochs, overlapping migration states and durable match/notice identity.
Fixtures cover offline owners, old/new epoch queries, retries, restart, withdrawal and delayed messages at the boundary.
steps: Rotate epochs while executing bilingual queries and match notification flows before, during and after migration.
Replay exact retries and delayed old-epoch messages; attempt stale/ambiguous epoch negatives.
Measure quality delta and compare delivered matches, user notices, gaps, durable originals and retention/deletion state.
expected: Rotation loses at most five percentage points of K5 quality while all absolute quality/privacy thresholds still pass.
No match-notification gap or doubled user notice occurs across the epoch boundary, retries or restarts.
Old/stale epochs cannot bypass scope, policy or withdrawal semantics; originals and required evidence remain intact.
Migration retention and deletion behavior matches the reviewed register.
evidence_required: Stale-epoch negative results and lifecycle audit

cases.title: K6 busy sparse and colluding observer games with joint budgets
preconditions: A reviewed transport candidate declares passive single-hop, cooperating-hop, multiple-domain Sybil and cross-session timing observers, compromised roles, auxiliary knowledge, candidate populations, chosen-query opportunities and observation windows.
Training/test splits are frozen by session/user and real observers do not receive artificial trial boundaries.
Busy, sparse and colluding-relay scenarios are separate and run jointly with K1/K7 measurements.
steps: Run separate activity-detection and source-to-operation-linking games for every declared attack in busy, sparse and colluding scenarios.
Inspect entry plaintext and destination source addresses directly.
Measure AUC including score reversal, per-scenario latency/success, all-edge bytes, wakeups and physical energy; retain the inherited 32/32 linkage baseline as historical failure only.
expected: Entry observes no direct operation plaintext and destination observes no original source address.
For each declared attack, AUC is <=0.55 separately for busy, sparse and colluding-relay scenarios, with activity and source-linking games reported separately.
All K1 latency/success and K7 latency/resource/network/power budgets hold jointly; averages cannot hide a failing scenario or game.
Finite attack results are presented only for the declared observers, not universal anonymity.
evidence_required: Joint K1/K7 resource and independent privacy review

cases.title: K7 process-tree memory CPU and physical power envelope
preconditions: The frozen candidate runs at reference load and fixed cardinality on named physical reference devices without concurrent builds/tests/workloads.
Power baselines match OS, brightness and power settings; cold model download/initialization and unlock are separate phases.
Idle means no new user work while enrolled roles and ordinary maintenance remain active for 30 minutes.
steps: Measure complete app and model-free relay process-tree RSS through cold startup, unlock and steady operation, including sustained fixed-cardinality operation for at least 30 minutes.
Measure idle CPU for 30 minutes and incremental physical client/relay power against the matched baseline.
Enforce configured disk/network limits and accepted-obligation reserves using exhaustion and temporary-replacement negative cases.
expected: Application RSS is <=1.5 GiB sustained and <=2 GiB during startup; model-free relay RSS is <=512 MiB at reference load.
Idle CPU is <=1% of one core; incremental idle power is <=1 W client and <=3 W relay.
Cold costs are not hidden in warm results and physical power is measured rather than inferred from CPU seconds.
Disk/network limits and reserves refuse unfunded new work without blocking required repair, acknowledgement or withdrawal safety behavior.
evidence_required: Process-tree RSS/CPU time series and 30-minute windows

cases.title: K7 all-edge network cost includes failures and maintenance
preconditions: The frozen candidate and nominal/impaired workloads identify every physical network edge and direction, including relay forwarding and independent observer-privacy schedules.
Accounting covers TLS, discovery, issuance, background maintenance, retries, failed attempts, recovery and model initialization.
steps: Run nominal completed-operation workloads and count each physical edge once per direction without double-counting virtual hops.
Inject failures/retries and zero-completion negative controls; report initialization/recovery separately and in full-lifecycle totals.
Reconcile per-edge captures with operation completions and K6 schedules under joint latency/resource constraints.
expected: Aggregate nominal network traffic is <=1 MiB per completed operation including failed-attempt costs.
All physical edges, TLS/discovery/issuance/maintenance/retries and initialization/recovery are included with separate and lifecycle totals.
Zero completions yields infinite bytes/completion rather than a zero or omitted cost.
The network result holds jointly with K1 and K6 rather than disabling privacy schedules to reduce bytes.
evidence_required: Per-edge byte captures and completion/retry denominators

cases.title: K8 fourteen-day independent volunteer pilot
preconditions: At least five genuinely independent operators across at least three networks agree to the approved pilot and run the same frozen candidate.
Every required owner, witness, policy/history quorum and route is represented; supported OS families, NAT and reviewed data/retention/incident guidance are present.
The 14-day wall-clock probe plan includes unreachable nodes and absent quorums rather than only successful service samples.
steps: Operate continuously for 14 days through natural shutdowns, correlated outages, NAT conditions, TLS renewal, reconnections and ordinary maintenance.
Measure every wall-clock window, each required quorum separately, conditional service success and reconnection recovery after usable dependencies return.
Collect sanitized operator/incident/retention evidence and verify cohort/device independence.
expected: The pilot lasts 14 days with >=5 independent operators and >=3 networks and includes all supported OS families and declared events.
End-to-end wall-clock availability is >=99% including missing-quorum windows; each quorum's availability and conditional success are separately reported.
Reconnection recovery p95 is <=5 minutes with earlier dependency outages separately visible.
Results qualify only observed conditions and do not claim unrestricted population availability.
Operator guidance, incidents and data handling follow the reviewed registers without sensitive content in delivery evidence.
evidence_required: Sanitized incident/data-handling audit and independent K8 review

cases.title: Production role data-flow and authenticated-interface negative audit
preconditions: A complete production-path inventory covers every personal, relay, issuer, wallet, policy, witness, local desktop and OS-service inbound/outbound interface.
The frozen build enables actual production routing rather than an opt-in test harness.
steps: Send malformed, oversized, replayed, stale, conflicting, unauthenticated and wrongly signed messages to every path with invalid keys/storage and expired cutoff.
Attempt cross-role key/store access, raw-text/true-embedding/channel-plaintext export, stable cross-activity correlation, unverified peer dialing and non-loopback desktop binding.
Test Host/Origin/Bearer negatives and verify no hosted inference or AI eligibility path exists.
Map every accepted field and error to the declared trust/data contract.
expected: Every path enforces mapped authentication, canonical signatures, bounded schemas/frames/deadlines and key storage; all negatives fail closed without partial effects.
Raw text, true embeddings, root/role-private keys and channel plaintext never leave their authorized personal/role boundary.
Relays receive only declared fingerprints/scoped IDs/network metadata/ciphertext; no stable root identity or unapproved provider route appears.
Desktop remains loopback with Host/Origin/Bearer controls and protocol authentication is not bypassed.
A reproducible safety/privacy violation blocks release regardless of other gate averages.

cases.title: Exact originals consent denial withdrawal and recovery semantics
preconditions: The integrated candidate includes actual personal/role-private state, consent channels, durable original operations and reviewed retention guidance.
Scenarios include lost replies, late certificates, conflicting cuts, split uncertainty, restarts, permanent denial and withdrawal before/after replication.
steps: Exercise original publish/match/consent/disclose/close/withdraw operations and exact retries through crashes and returning owners.
Deny consent/admission permanently where specified and retry; attempt disclosure without mutual consent and withdrawal resurrection after recovery.
Inspect user-visible outcome text, peer/relay plaintext visibility, originals/rights/evidence and retention/deletion effects.
expected: Only explicit mutual consent creates the fresh pairwise relationship and only peers access channel plaintext.
Exact retries preserve original identity/outcome and produce no duplicate notice; permanent denials remain denied and uncertainty is never presented as success.
Original pins, evidence, rights and required proofs survive recovery; withdrawals never resurrect and failed allocations are not refunded to manufacture capacity.
User-visible retry/error/notice text matches durable state and withdrawal/tombstone behavior is not misdescribed as guaranteed physical erasure.
evidence_required: Consent/denial/retry/notice screenshots or accessible UI capture
Role plaintext visibility and original-evidence audit

cases.title: Supported platform package SBOM license notice and accessibility review
preconditions: One frozen release candidate has macOS ARM64 and Windows/Linux x64 packages, a complete source/dependency/model/native SBOM and proposed notices; installer execution is separately authorized at that future stage.
Accessibility reviewers have the actual desktop build and keyboard/assistive-technology review setup.
steps: Install, enable/disable the optional relay service, upgrade/remove and restart on each supported platform while recording explicit OS effects and personal/role storage separation.

Verify loopback Host/Origin/Bearer behavior in packaged mode and reconcile every shipped artifact against SBOM, root MIT LICENSE and dependency/model/native notices, including a packaged-LICENSE-missing negative check.
Complete keyboard-only publish/search/inbox/consent/error/notice/relay journeys and inspect focus, accessible names, readability and status announcements.
Have release-engineering, accessibility and supply-chain/legal reviewers record findings against the rubric.
expected: Every supported package preserves local boundary controls, separate personal/relay identities/data and explicit reversible service effects without unexpected external effects.
The package contains the root LICENSE and all required reviewed dependency/model/native notices; SBOM identities match shipped artifacts with no unexplained component.
All critical desktop journeys are keyboard operable with visible focus, accessible names and understandable consent/error/notice states; no blocking accessibility finding remains.
Human reviewers sign the evidence for the exact candidate; package success does not imply legal or production approval.

rubric.pass_threshold: Every criterion accepted with no open blocking finding; weights prioritize review coverage and do not average away a failure.
rubric.judge: Independent release-engineering, accessibility and supply-chain/legal reviewers

evidence_required: SBOM and package reconciliation plus LICENSE/notices
Named human review decisions tied to candidate identity

cases.title: Human legal deployment retention incident and vendor review
preconditions: Qualified legal/privacy/security reviewers receive the actual deployment description, jurisdictions, entities, users/sectors, data flows, stores, vendors/transfers, model BOM, SBOM and incident/rights procedures.
No reviewer is asked to rely on categorical statements in COMPLIANCE.md or agent legal inference.
steps: Workshops identify applicable obligations, lawful bases, controller/processor roles, consent/notices, age/sector limits, international transfers and vendor/subprocessor terms for each deployment.
Review per-data retention/deletion/correction/backup/evidence exceptions, operator registers, incident response, license/notices and security/release baseline.
Record decisions, open findings, owners, expiry/review triggers and whether local prototyping, pilot or production is permitted.
expected: Named qualified humans document deployment-specific decisions rather than a global inferred compliance conclusion.
Jurisdictions, lawful bases, roles, retention, transfers, vendor terms, incident handling and release approvals are explicitly resolved or remain release-blocking.
Operator guidance matches actual scoped identities, failed privacy baselines and retention behavior; no unsupported non-personal/non-invertible or blanket open-source-exemption claim is accepted.
All required CMP approvals for the intended deployment are recorded before production release.

rubric.pass_threshold: All required deployment decisions and controls accepted by accountable humans; no unresolved release-blocking finding.
rubric.judge: Qualified legal/privacy, operator security and supply-chain reviewers

evidence_required: Named approvals, limitations, owners and review triggers

cases.title: Model provenance cache supply chain and inference lifecycle bounds
preconditions: The frozen model BOM identifies nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1 revision, tokenizer/config, ONNX weights/external data, Transformers.js/ONNX/native runtime, hashes, licenses and notices.
Cache is empty for cold cases and populated for warm cases; network and filesystem request recording is enabled in an isolated future qualification environment.
steps: Perform first download/initialization and warm reuse; compare every artifact against the pinned BOM and inspect all requested hosts/redirects/paths.
Inject partial/corrupt/oversized artifacts, unrelated hosts, redirects, traversal, invalid vectors and resource exhaustion; verify atomic cache behavior.
Measure bounded input/concurrency/cancellation, startup/steady/idle resources and ensure no raw text/true embeddings leave the personal node or any hosted fallback occurs.
Reconcile model/runtime notices with the release SBOM and package.
expected: Cold and warm paths use the exact reviewed 768-dimensional local artifact set and produce finite vectors with deterministic downstream pipeline identity.
Only approved model artifact requests occur; unsafe/unrelated/partial/oversized content fails without poisoning cache or publishing output.
Inference resource/lifecycle behavior satisfies AI-004 and contributes to K7 limits with cold costs separately visible.
No hosted provider, telemetry text route, unreviewed substitution or AI eligibility decision exists; required model/native notices ship in the package.
evidence_required: Signed-off model BOM and artifact hashes
Cold/warm network/cache trace and negative matrix

cases.title: Documentation and privacy-claims consistency review
preconditions: Reviewers receive README, protocol/privacy/user/operator documentation, COMPLIANCE.md, package notices, current evaluation evidence and the frozen candidate data-flow register.
The review covers user-facing downloads, source use, relay operation, volunteer pilot and professional/sensitive-use claims.
steps: Compare every privacy, anonymity, retention, erasure, legal, AI, availability and release statement against actual architecture and evidence.

Search for categorical open-source exemptions, non-personal/non-invertible fingerprint claims, persistent-DID descriptions, fixed unsupported retention and claims that two-hop HPKE or local tests qualify K5/K6/K8.
Verify limitations, consent/retries/notices, role/data ownership, independent-operator conditions and pending approvals are understandable and consistent.
expected: No document presents K1-K8 accepted, release approved, legal compliance inferred, current fingerprints confidential or current transport observer-private.
Known K5/K6 failures, research-prototype status, exact retention uncertainty and scoped data visibility are disclosed where relevant.
No stale legal/privacy statement remains normative without qualified review; root MIT and packaged third-party/model/native notices are distinguished.
Documentation, operator guidance, user-visible states and actual frozen behavior agree, with all blocking findings resolved by accountable humans.

rubric.pass_threshold: No unsupported categorical or release-blocking claim remains and accountable reviewers accept every criterion.
rubric.judge: Independent privacy/security reviewer with qualified legal/privacy and product documentation owners
